name: slrr_part_wear
title: Wrench Works: Part Wear
tagline: Parts of your car wear out, look worn and can fail: shocks, brakes, engine, driveline, body, cabin and more
description: Every part of the car has a condition that goes down as you drive, brake hard, land jumps and run hot, and a worn part changes how the car drives: shocks bounce more, springs sit lower, brakes fade, the engine loses power, the clutch slips, rims, cabin and paint look worn. Badly worn parts can fail by chance, with a warning first (off by default). Worn parts are repaired or replaced in the Wrench Works garage for money. Everything is off until you switch it on in ESC > Mods > Part wear. Works with or without Wrench Works (the garage repair needs it), and the paint look needs Car Surface FX.
author: Connor Moyle
